message.content:
Here are a few well‑known documentaries that focus on global warming and climate change:

| Title | Release Year | Director | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|----------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Davis Guggenheim | Former Vice President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change and urges action. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | Davis Guggenheim | A follow‑up to the original film, exploring progress (or lack thereof) since 2006. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Fisher Stevens | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to investigate the impacts of climate change and potential solutions. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | Various | A concise overview of the science behind climate change, featuring interviews with leading experts. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Leila Conners | A documentary that examines the environmental crisis and offers possible solutions. |
| **Our Planet** (Series) | 2019 | David Attenborough | While not solely about climate change, this series highlights how global warming affects ecosystems worldwide. |

These films are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or through educational distributors. Let me know if you’d like more detailed information on any of them!
